about: When each nursery ships, rated for a late-fall arrival in Annandale, NJ. safe = dormant or timed to your zone; ask = fine if you pick or request the ship date; risky = ships potted/green on order in any season; unknown = not published.

advanced-nursery-growers.why: No shipping season published. Ask when they'll ship before ordering.

arborday.why: Ships at the right planting time for your zone.

beautiful-beginnings.why: Ships spring and autumn, not stated by zone; confirm the fall date.
